title: Mova’s latest robot vacuum solves the kitchen stool problem
summary: Its latest robot vacuum and mop — the V70 Ultra Complete ($1,299.99) , launching today — features a mop on an articulating arm that can reach almost 7 inches out from the robot, along with a side brush that extends 5 inches.
